summary.content:
Today's selection covers 72 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 49 on Artificial Intelligence and 13 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: An Anthropic Claude AI Model Finds Flaws in Tough-to-Crack Encryption Algorithms
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Police Say Binance Is Making It Harder to Fight Crime
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, BBC Technology, The Verge, SecurityWeek, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 51 articles published in the last 24 hours
